status: Partial Peep/owned-eye implementation checkpoint. Full 653-record goal remains active.

native.basis: 41 of 42 passed in the complete run; enemy_port_coverage passed on a targeted rerun after the regenerated reference fingerprint was re-audited. Not a claim of one clean 42-suite run.

behavior.covered: Thresholds, initial cyan parts, yellow size/trail, 8/12-shot attacks, locked swept jump, stun, airborne adaptation, vulnerability recovery, wall/body reflection, cover flight, real projectile blocking and bomb direction, capacity retry, no orphan/duplicate slots, room re-entry mid-flight, one-time rewards.
behavior.wasm_observations: Isolated forms emitted 8-shot rings and creep. Actual cyan stage was airborne at frame 131, emitted 12 landing shots by frame 211 and 24 after two completed jumps by frame 361. Component ownership/thresholds and execution cleanup were checked on the real WASM build.

reachability.scope: Caves-equivalent Broken Quarry dedicated encounter; source double/degraded later-route placements remain open. Ordinary/conditional 25-ID roster remains reachable; components are not independent room threats.

configuration.coverage: Bad/duplicate IDs/forms/controllers/weights rejected. File-only action and boss pool weights apply to new snapshots, preserve existing snapshots, ordinary composition RNG, topology/heightfields and tutorial routing.

balance.scope: Simple circular movement/fire/dodge bot in a synthetic enclosed room. Does not certify human difficulty, varied builds or actual mixed expeditions.

visuals.observation: Inspected native and browser captures. Attached/empty sockets and separate eye bodies are visible; cyan and yellow have distinct colors/scale; natural cyan jump shows elevated body, shadow and landing marker. Yellow shots are visible against sand, but bright-ground contrast and eyes behind minimap/foreground remain limitations. Simple spherical body is provisional, not final silhouette acceptance.

performance.scope: Capacity/slot limits, short bounded patch refresh and finite arc planning tested. No controlled Linux/WASM performance signoff; changing concurrent build/test load makes HUD FPS and wall times unsuitable for comparison.

failures_resolved: Coverage audit expected the older reference SHA because the generated dataset was refreshed before its checklist identity audit; audited all 653 XML tuples again, preserved decisions, reran failing coverage suite.
Initial eye-cover fixture omitted rebuilding flight-cover metadata after editing obstacles; corrected fixture to use real Arena::rebuildWalls and verified actual airborne height.
Invalid component ID triggered generic death-ownership validation first; moved component structural validation earlier for precise diagnostics. Final mechanics suite passes.
limitations: Chaos Card, Euthanasia, God's Flesh and Little Horn item-specific eye destruction remains unimplemented. Generic debug execution is not parity evidence for these items.
Native attack selection probabilities, exact timing and damage windows are not established by the preserved article/XML sources.
Double-boss/degraded later-stage encounter routes need their own reviewed placement contract; current reachability is the dedicated Caves-equivalent pool only.
Bloat and Bloat Eye encounter remain a separate unfinished port.
All-camera mixed-threat readability, diverse player builds/skill balance, and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
